title: Ice Queen of the North
description: A pale female figure with white eyes stands on a snowy cliff, wearing an ornate icy crown and a flowing purple and blue gown with frost details. She holds a large, intricate ice spear in her right hand while a translucent veil covers part of her face and hair against a dark, dramatic sky with glowing beams of light.
prompt: A regal ice sorceress with pale skin and glowing white eyes stands on a snowy mountain peak at night. She wears an intricate crown of ice and thorns, a flowing purple and blue medieval gown with frost patterns, and a translucent veil. In her hand she holds a tall, ornate spear made of ice with sharp blades. Dramatic beams of purple light cut through a dark, snowy sky with floating ice particles, epic fantasy style, cinematic lighting.
